sha_binding.anchor_note:
54ae783b7 is the merge of origin/main into this branch, taken with `ops:merge-wrapper git-merge-main` rather than a rebase because this branch carries a proof bundle and a rebase would rewrite the history the bundle is bound to. It is the current PR head and the tree every command above was run against.

This is the seventh anchor on this lane. The wrapper itself warned that the sync moves the head SHA and invalidates every head-pinned governance artifact, and that warning was followed rather than worked around: verify re-run on the new head, then a fresh EXECUTOR_RESULT pinned to it, then approval last, so the artifact that authorises the merge certifies the head that actually merges.

What the resync brought in is measurable and small: `git diff 1cbc55c3f...origin/main --name-only` was three files -- .ops/sync/UTV2-1858.yml, docs/06_status/lanes/UTV2-1858.json and docs/mission/plan.md -- and no code at all. The type-check and test receipts are therefore identical to the previous anchor's, and that identity is evidence rather than an omission: the suite was re-run and returned the same numbers because nothing it measures changed. The r-level count did move, 16 to 13, because the merge turned imported files into common ancestry and shrank the branch-versus-main diff.

Rule 4 of scripts/ci/proof-binding-validator.ts is a two-dot `git diff verified_source_sha..HEAD`, so any commit after this anchor must stay inside PROOF_ONLY_PREFIXES for the binding to hold. The only commit after it is this bundle update, which does.
